title: RareEvent ClassificationKPI

stats.done_summary: Successfully completed the RareEvent ClassificationKPI research task. Computed the Temporal Stability Index (TSI) for the 5000-frame trace following laboratory protocol: split into 5 blocks of 1000 frames, computed TSI for each block (0.9171, 0.9596, 0.9077, 0.8991, 0.9117), and calculated mean full-trace TSI = 0.9190. Generated comprehensive analysis code, visualizations, and a publication-quality research report with methodology, results, and discussion. All deliverables are complete and validated.
